caption:
On punctuation questions, don't stop reading at the blank.

"The museum closed in March ___ reopening in June" takes a comma. "The museum closed in March ___ it reopened in June" needs a semicolon or period. Same start, different answer.

Save this for your next practice test.
tiktok_caption: Don't stop reading at the blank. On SAT punctuation, the ending decides.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar Tip: Read Past the Blank on Punctuation
youtube.description: On digital SAT punctuation questions, what comes after the blank decides between a comma and a semicolon or period.
